1000–1200 m // 422 HP

1000–1200 Meter Truck-Mounted Rotary Drilling Rig

Rapid Highway Deployment, 90-Ton Mast Load & Integrated Mud Pumping

Engineering Overview & Purpose

Combining heavy-duty deep drilling power with self-propelled mobility, the KD-1200 truck-mounted rotary rig delivers 1200-meter drilling capability powered by a 422 HP deck engine, 90-ton mast capacity, and standard integrated mud pumps for municipal water and mining exploration.

Field Applications

  • ✓ Municipal and agricultural deep water wells up to 1200 meters
  • ✓ Geothermal gradient and reconnaissance exploration wells
  • ✓ Continuous mineral exploration coring and geophysical logging
Geological Stratum Compatibility:

Limestone, sandstone, shale, gravel layers, and volcanic formations.

Engineering Q&A Direct Answers

Q: What is the difference between truck-mounted and trailer-mounted drilling rigs?

A: Truck-mounted rigs are self-propelled on commercial multi-axle truck chassis for rapid mobilization across highways and varied sites without external tractors. Trailer rigs are dedicated heavy-duty platforms designed for higher hook-loads (110+ tons) and deeper depths (up to 3000m).
